summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Finance Nunes. 44/44 pytest backend tests pass (auth, isolation, transactions, installments, recurring, budgets, goals, summary/50-30-20, chat SSE streaming, brute-force lockout). Full UI happy path verified on desktop and mobile (390px): login (wrong password error), register throwaway user, admin login, dashboard stats + month switcher + rule card + donut + history chart, create 3x installment with 'R$ 1.234,56' format, create income, Movimentações search/filter/count, Planejamento (recurring/budget/goal/goal-contribute added, installment card shows 3 rows), AI assistant streams reply and persists history across reload, profile name edit saves, mobile bottom-nav visible.

issues: Recharts logs repeated console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Visuals render correctly but noisy console. Likely ResponsiveContainer measuring during initial render — consider wrapping with a min-h container or setting an explicit aspect/minHeight to silence.

action_items: Optional: silence recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer parents an explicit min-height or by setting aspect.

Optional cleanup: admin account now has leftover UI-created items ('UI test receita' income R$100, 'UI test compra parcelada' 3x R$1.234,56 in compras, recurring 'UI assinatura' R$29,90 day 10 mercado, budget compras R$2000, goal 'UI meta' R$1000 with R$100 contributed, admin profile name was reset to 'Rian Nunes'). Remove if you want a clean seed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 311: comparing str(other['_id']) to user.id works because PyObjectId coerces _id to str on load; OK.
server.py set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True, correct for cross-site preview URL with httpOnly cookies.
Login lockout logic correct: 5th failure sets locked_until, after window expires it is cleared (test_brute_force_lockout passes).
Chat endpoint catches exceptions and emits SSE 'error' event; swallows traceback (logged) and still writes 'done' — good UX.
server.py is 687 lines (near the 700-line soft cap); consider splitting into routers (auth, transactions, planning, chat) soon.

update_recurring: if body.start_month is empty-string it would fail check_month regex; current frontend sends a valid value or omits, so fine, but input model allows Optional[str] without stripping empty string — minor hardening possible.
No rate limiting on /auth/register — someone could spam user creation. Low priority.
test_credentials: Admin rian@financenunes.com / Nunes@2026 (seeded). Throwaway users registered during tests use TEST_* or ttest_* email prefixes.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_* prefixed users/transactions/goals/budgets/recurring/installments (self-cleaning where applicable). UI test left items on admin account (see action_items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified end-to-end against public preview URL. Admin has test leftovers; delete if desired. Brute-force lockout test uses a fresh throwaway so admin is never locked. SSE chat streaming works with model 'claude-sonnet-5-5' via Emergent LLM key.
